recipe.name: UwU Minecraft bot
evidence: start runs tools/boot.sh under Bun: repairs+verifies 26.3 support, then execs standalone.js
NOT a web service - no HTTP port. Readiness is command-based: RCON 'list' must
show UwU in the player list (not just the port being open), so this verifies she
actually joined the world rather than that the server is up.
